# SCOPE Source

This is SCOPE's canonical `source` branch. It contains the Rust implementation,
tests, documentation inputs, localization catalogs, and publication tooling.

Contributors target pull requests at `source`. Automation owns the generated
`canary`, `beta`, and `stable` branches; do not edit them directly.

- [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md) defines the contributor workflow.
- [`TRANSLATORS.md`](TRANSLATORS.md) defines the localization workflow.
- [`.scope/knowledge/shared/architecture/README.md`](../.scope/knowledge/shared/architecture/README.md) defines the system layers.
